---
title: "Settings [⌘,]{.kbd}"
pagetitle: "Settings"
subtitle: "Nine sections in a window of their own, from Appearance to About."
---

## Appearance {.i-palette}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-appearance" aria-label="The Appearance section of Emaki's settings: under You, the avatar with Choose and Remove, and the name; under Window, the theme, System, Light or Dark, and the seven accents, the chosen one ringed and named. A click picks a theme or an accent."}
:::

Your avatar and name, the window's theme, and its accent: Periwinkle, Orchid, Rose, Amber, Moss, Jade or Teal.

## Fonts {.i-typography}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-fonts" aria-label="The Fonts section of Emaki's settings: the chat's font, four serif faces and four sans serif faces, each a tile with its name, and the monospace font, four faces. A click on a tile chooses it."}
:::

Eight faces for the chat, four serif and four sans serif, and four monospace faces for code and the terminals.

## Text Size {.i-a-large-small}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-text" aria-label="The Text Size section of Emaki's settings: Small, Medium, Large or Custom, and under it the size of the conversation, the composer, the file preview, the file editor and the terminal, each with a step down and a step up. A click picks a preset; under Custom the steps change a size."}
:::

Small, Medium and Large set every place at once. Custom is your own set: each place's size, stepped a point at a time or typed.

## Composer {.i-keyboard}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-composer" aria-label="The Composer section of Emaki's settings: the key that sends, ⌘↩ or ↩, auto-capitalization, and spelling and grammar checked as you type in one of five languages. A click flips a switch or picks a choice; with the check off, the languages are dimmed."}
:::

The key that sends, auto-capitalization, and spelling and grammar checked as you type, in US or UK English, Spanish, French or German. Spanish, French and German are checked on a Mac only.

## New sessions {.i-square-terminal}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-sessions" aria-label="The New sessions section of Emaki's settings: Claude Code's permission mode, model and effort for a new session, and the two agents' marks at the right of its head. A click on a mark shows that agent's three; a click on a field turns it to the next choice."}
:::

Each agent's permission mode, model and effort for a new session. The pills under the composer change them for one session ([Chats](chats.qmd#mode-model-and-effort)).

## Terminal {.i-terminal}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-terminal" aria-label="The Terminal section of Emaki's settings: under Look, the theme, the cursor, whether it blinks, the font and the size; under Behavior, ligatures and copy on select. A click flips a switch or picks a choice."}
:::

The terminal's theme, its cursor, ligatures and copy on select. Its face is set in Fonts and its size in Text Size.

## Files {.i-tree-view}

::: {.fig .settings-fig data-figure="settings-files" aria-label="The Files section of Emaki's settings: format on save, and the languages it covers, each ticked, with its formatter. A click ticks a language; with format on save off, the languages are dimmed."}
:::

Format on save, and the languages it covers, each with its own formatter.
